title: helm.episode.status.v1
description: Machine-readable detail a worker attaches to a status update: what an INPUT_REQUIRED episode is waiting on, why a FAILED or REJECTED episode ended, or the applied report of a COMPLETED one. Carried as a data part (media type application/vnd.helm.episode.status.v1+json) of status.message and mirrored, member by member, in the event metadata.

waiting_on.description: Present on INPUT_REQUIRED. Every key present must be satisfied before the continuation starts.

attempts.description: Gateway attempt ids that returned ESCALATED for this episode.

children.description: Work item ids delegated by this episode. Empty when the delegate results did not name them; the control plane knows the children it created for the episode.

report.description: Present on COMPLETED: the helm_work_report arguments the gateway applied.
